entities.summary: Grayson Scott "The Professor" Boucher is an American professional streetball player. He is most known for playing on the highly stylized, international AND1 Mixtape Tour; he has also appeared in several movies including Semi-Pro, Ball Don't Lie, and Hustle, and he is a playable character in several video games.
